body.name: dense ternary witness with displayed selected matrices
body.construction: Take \(q=3\), \(K=3\), \(J=8\), \(S_1=(1,2,3)\), \(S_2=(4,5,6)\), \(S_3=(7,8)\), \(\rho_1=(1,2,3)\), \(\rho_2=(2,1,3)\), graph \(\Gamma^{\star}\), the empty latent DAG, and law \(P^{\star}\). With \(Q_3=I_3-\mathbf1\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}/3\), the six selected matrices are \(B_{1,1,\varnothing}=\frac13\mathbf1\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{11}Q_3\), \(B_{1,2,(u_1)}=b^{\star}_{2,(u_1)}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{22}Q_3\), \(B_{1,3,(u_1,u_2)}=b^{\star}_{3,(u_1,u_2)}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{33}Q_3\), \(B_{2,1,\varnothing}=\frac13\mathbf1\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{42}Q_3\), \(B_{2,2,(u_2)}=b^{\star}_{5,(u_2)}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{51}Q_3\), and \(B_{2,3,(u_2,u_1)}=b^{\star}_{6,(u_2,u_1)}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{63}Q_3\), for every displayed predecessor context.
